newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Macmed to buy two Namibian medical firms.
newsitem.headline: Macmed to buy two Namibian medical firms.

text.p: Macmed Health Care Ltd said on Thursday it had agreed to buy Namibian medical suppliers Bio Dynamics (Pty) Ltd and Bio Scientific (Pty) Ltd for 3.4 million rand.
The purchase consideration will be settled by the issue of 1.28 million Macmed ordinary shares at 2.65 rand each.

Macmed said the deal would help it expand its export drive into southern Africa. Had the transaction been in effect for the six months ended September 30, there would have been no material effect on Macmed's earnings per share or net asset value.
The acquisition will take effect from February 1, 1997.
